figures.purpose: Instructional comparison of three centrally thinner glass-lens profiles in air; the count, ordering, and profile-side directions come from pixels, not prose.
recoverable: Exactly three separated upright profiles with approximately aligned ends.
Left: nearly straight right side and left side bowed rightward at center.
Middle: both sides bow leftward, with the right side having a greater inward displacement.
Right: two sides bow toward each other at center.
Each center is visibly thinner than its ends.
No visible rays, arrows, labels, points, or given dimensions.
